character.morphology: Catalog record 12, generation1, familyBits0. Tiny limbless aquatic/dragonfolk larva with a slender soft body, left-facing face opening and paired horn-like fins. It is neither biped nor quadruped.
character.locomotion: The entire soft body bobs, curls, stretches vertically, sweeps horizontally and collapses flat. Preserve the single continuous body axis and every tall/flat extreme; do not invent walking limbs.
character.faceAndExpression: The left-facing face opening changes from a small slit to a wide red open expression in cells08/12/24/35/39/51/54/58/60, and is compressed or occluded in cells13/23/40/62. Do not place the same smiling face on every frame.
character.appendages: Exactly the source-visible paired horn-fins/crest lobes attached to the upper body. Their separation, fold and sweep follow each source cell; no arms, legs, tail, ears or extra fins.
character.restraint: Main027..043 are restrained variants: gold binding wraps the central/main body while the horn-fins and face remain readable. The wrap follows tall, curled and flattened poses and never becomes anatomy.
character.specialStates: Main044/46 red-orange,047/048 black silhouettes,061 stone/gray and064 white silhouette. Derive deterministically only when exact alpha/palette relations are proved; otherwise author once.
character.contactAndOrigin: Fixed NCER origin [31, 38] in a logical64x64 canvas at native scale1. Never recenter or autofit individual cells. Preserve Main/Sub aliases, translations and all53 raw sequences with original ticks, loops and stops.

designLimitations: Current original water-dragon identity is a reviewed standard-pose candidate; generation is for multi-pose continuity review and does not grant runtime promotion.
